verdict_reason: The file is part of a rebase fix that reverts main's EUDPA-696 Design Release 2.1 check-answers species view model to an older shape, leaving main's identification-details builders dead and duplicated.

todos.issue: identifier-table.js arrives in rebase-fix commit 714a8f5 ('Restore the pre-rebase check-answers view model'), reverting main's EUDPA-696 Design Release 2.1 review (#484) outside this ticket's scope. On main (32236d4) description-of-goods.js builds cards from commodityCards -> speciesBlock -> identificationDetailsTable, and template.njk renders card.speciesBlocks with each animal labelled animalLabelOf(speciesName, n) and an identification-details Change link. On this branch description-of-goods.js uses speciesCards -> identifierTable, which labels rows copy.identifierTable.animalN(n) ('Animal 2') with no species name and no table Change link, and template.njk renders card.identifierTable. identification-details-table.js, species-block.js and commodity-cards.js are left with no production caller, and identifierTable copies identificationDetailsTable's body (lines 10-27 vs identification-details-table.js:17-33). Merging ships the older review page over the agreed 2.1 design. EUDPA-776 only removes the contact address page.
todos.fix: Must: the check-answers view model, template and copy on this branch match main's EUDPA-696 shape (commodityCards/speciesBlock/identificationDetailsTable) with only the contact address page's parts removed, and no second identifier-table builder exists. One way: redo the rebase conflict resolution taking main's check-answers files, re-apply only the contact-address removals, and delete identifier-table.js, species-cards.js, species-card-*.js and the species-folder units-for-commodity-line.js the revert brought back.
